messages:
emma: Seeing weird client reconnects for a subset of streaming customers after the console rollout. Reconnects spike ~30s after stream starts. Not sure if it's client or proxy.
raj: Are these SSE clients or websockets? Any pattern in headers?
emma: Mostly SSE clients, mixed regions. I pulled logs: proxy sends 200 then chunked stream. After ~30s client issues a new GET -> resume token missing -> duplicate sessions.
console-bot: rollout v2.3 to eng-prod completed at 2026-03-18T14:02Z 
sre-oncall: Can you paste proxy keepalive/timeout values? We had a change last week to reduce idle timeout.
emma: proxy.conf has `proxy_read_timeout 45s`, nginx -> 60s for upstream. But console sampling shows "last_event" metric missing for some tenants.
hao: We saw earlier a race where the keepalive probe is interpreted as a heartbeat and resets the session TTL incorrectly. Might be related.
maria: Any telemetry gaps? Which metrics missing? latency, last_event, resume_attempts?
emma: last_event and resume_attempts under-sampled for ~20% of streams. Dashboard shows 1m sampling, but traces indicate full traces.
raj: Could be our console sidecar sampling not tagging opaque_session_id. If sampling drops, console won't show reconnection chain.
emma: repro steps: `curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' https://api.redwood/apps/stream?tenant=acme` -> stream starts; then client does a `GET /stream?resume=...` returns 200 new session. logs: `session=opaque:abc123 keepalive=probe` then `session=opaque:abc123 closed by client`.
hao: quick fix idea: change probe to use `X-Stream-Probe: 1` header so we treat it as non-heartbeat for TTL.
sre-oncall: That's backwards compatible? Some customers use proxies that strip unknown headers.
raj: Alternatively, bump sampling window in console or annotate probe events specially in telemetry pipeline.
emma: For a proper fix we need: 1) idempotent handling for probe resends from proxies, 2) update console to correlate resume attempts by `session_claim_id`, 3) rollout canary with traffic filtering.
maria: Can we add a short alert for `resume_attempts > 3` in 1m for a tenant? That would catch regressions.
emma: I'll open a canary PR, add metrics, and put a temporary patch to treat `keepalive=probe` as sticky (not reset TTL). Will post link.
console-bot: PR #4123 opened by emma: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/4123
sre-oncall: Nice. Add runbook note: if weird reconns spike, flip rollout to previous canary and set sampling to 10s for affected tenants.
hao: small nit: ensure `resume_attempts` increments only on auth-successful resumes to avoid double-counting.
emma: Good call. I'll update PR.
raj: Thx. Let's monitor after canary. :rocket:
